channel.disclosure: Forwarded emails are processed in India. Forward only what you want CauseDeck to read. Client emails are excluded unless you choose to forward them.

address.title: Your intake address
address.description: Forward emails here. Only you and the workspace admins can see this address. Anyone who knows it can send to it, so keep it private.
address.label: Intake address
address.empty: You do not have an intake address yet.
address.rotateBody: A new address is created and the current one stops working at once. Emails sent to the old address will not arrive.
address.revokeBody: The address stops working at once and you will have no intake address until you create a new one.

allowlist.title: Allowed senders
allowlist.description: Emails from these senders are accepted. Add the courts, e-filing portals and counsel you expect to forward from.
allowlist.label: Label (optional)

aims.title: Set up AIMS cause-list emails
aims.description: Have your AIMS account email the daily cause list to your intake address.
aims.step2: In your AIMS account, add it as an email recipient for cause-list notifications.
aims.step3: Add the AIMS sender domain under Allowed senders as a court.
aims.note: CauseDeck only reads emails from senders on your list.

toast.rotated: Address rotated. The old one no longer works.
toast.error: Could not change it. Nothing was changed.
toast.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
toast.invalid: Check the email or domain and try again.
toast.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it instead.

importReview.title: Confirm what we found
importReview.intro: Each row is a matter we propose to create. Check it, fix it, then confirm. Nothing is created until you confirm.
importReview.empty: No matters were found in these files.
importReview.confirm: Confirm {count, plural, one {# matter} other {# matters}}
importReview.blockedNote: Pick a date for each conflicting matter before confirming.
importReview.failed: Could not confirm the import. Nothing was created. Try again.
importReview.saveFailed: Could not save your edits. Nothing was created.

grid.label: Proposed matters
grid.title: Matter title
grid.split: {label} is now a matter of its own.

conflict.title: Which date is right?
conflict.blocked: Blocked until you pick a date

preview.title: Sources
preview.empty: Select a matter to see where it came from.

issues.title: Needs a look
issues.missingIdentifiers: No enrolment number or name spelling saved, so no list rows were imported.
issues.unreadableCopy: Couldn't read this. Retake, type the key line, or keep as an attachment.
issues.a0Only: {name}: kept as an attachment, it needs a dedicated adapter

result.title: Import confirmed
result.created: {matters, plural, one {# matter} other {# matters}}, {proceedings, plural, one {# proceeding} other {# proceedings}}, {hearings, plural, one {# hearing} other {# hearings}}, {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} created.
result.duplicates: {count, plural, one {# matter was left out because it already exists} other {# matters were left out because they already exist}}.
result.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# proceeding needs a forum or case type before it can be created} other {# proceedings need a forum or case type before they can be created}}.

camera.title: Photograph a diary page
camera.description: Tomorrow's page? Hold steady, we will read it.
camera.guide: Place the diary page flat in good light.
camera.privacy: Photos stay in India and are deleted per your retention settings.
camera.captured: {count, plural, one {# page captured} other {# pages captured}}
camera.offline: Saved on this device. Will read when you're back online.

hints.glare: Glare on the page. Tilt it away from the light.

errors.open: Couldn't open the camera. Choose photos instead.
errors.process: Couldn't prepare this photo. Try again.
errors.save: Couldn't save this page on the device.

denied.title: Camera access is off
denied.body: You can still add photos from your gallery.
denied.steps: To use the camera, allow camera access for this site in your browser settings, then open this again.

crop.title: Adjust the page edges
crop.hint: Drag the four corners to the page edges. Arrow keys move a corner 4 px, Shift moves 16 px.

review.title: Review pages
review.upload: Upload {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}

recover.title: Pick up where you left off
recover.body: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} from an earlier session are saved on this device.

causeList.title: This looks like a cause list
causeList.copy: Printed cause lists are read by list import, not as a diary page.

receipt.title: Kept as an attachment
receipt.copy: Kept as an attachment. Fee tracking arrives later.

voice.title: Record a voice note
voice.description: Say the hearing, the next date or what to do. We will turn it into drafts for you to confirm.
voice.privacy: Audio stays in India and is deleted after 30 days. The transcript stays.

onboarding.title: Why we need your microphone
onboarding.why: To record the voice notes you make here. Nothing is recorded in the background.
onboarding.retention: The audio file is deleted after 30 days. You can delete a recording at any time.

record.hint: Hold, speak, release. Slide left to cancel.

review.title: Review your note
review.matterSearchPlaceholder: Search by title, party or case number
review.dateHintNote: A hint from this device only. Nothing is created from it.
review.notePlaceholder: Type the date or key line, if you want a hint

saved.online: Saved. We will transcribe it now.
saved.offline: Saved on this device. Will transcribe when you're back online.

denied.title: Microphone access is off
denied.steps: Allow microphone access for this site in your browser settings, then open this again.
denied.body: You can still add an audio file from the capture menu.

unavailable.title: This device can't record here
unavailable.body: Open CauseDeck in a current browser over a secure connection to record.

errors.save: Couldn't save this recording on the device.
errors.full: The device outbox is full. Let uploads finish, then try again.

error.title: Something went wrong.
error.description: Your saved work is safe. Try again, or go back to Today.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: You are offline. Saved court days and briefs remain available once synced.
